description: Grails RestfulController<Post> plus the GORM domain class it manages, in one file. Exercises: the Grails controller convention (every public action is an implicit /<controller>/<action> route), @Override'd RestfulController actions, a service field, and a GORM domain with a constraints closure and a static finder. Expectations written for #6273 — this directory carried src/ and no expected.json since it was added, so it produced no report and was graded by nothing.
selection_rule: Every member DECLARED in the source is gated must_exist, at the kind and name the rest of this corpus already uses for that construct: a class is SCOPE.Component, its fields are SCOPE.Schema named <Owner>.<field> (python-django-mini, kotlin-spring-mini and the Swift fixture all qualify field names; the Groovy path is the outlier that names them bare), its methods are SCOPE.Operation named bare. Nothing here is nice_to_have. An earlier draft demoted the field-name disagreements on the grounds that this fixture 'is not the place to pick the winner' — but the corpus HAS picked, three languages to one, so demoting them hid a real inconsistency behind a false neutrality.
known_wrong_edges_not_expressible: Two edges are emitted today and are WRONG, and the harness has no bucket for that. `update CALLS save` binds postService.save(post) to the controller's own save action, but postService is a PostService which is not in this tree. Listing it must_exist would lock the mis-binding in; nice_to_have would award it credit for being wrong; forbidden_relationships is the right shape but is scored as always-fatal (internal/quality/diff.go counts any match as a ForbiddenHit and scripts/quality/ratchet.py fails on forbidden_hits > 0), so a currently-emitted wrong edge cannot be recorded there without turning the gate red. It is therefore recorded only here, in prose the harness ignores. See the report on #6273 — this is a gap in the fixture schema, not a decision about this fixture.

expected_entities.name: PostController.postService
expected_entities.note: `PostService postService` — Grails by-name service injection. Emitted under no name and no kind: total absence, not a naming disagreement.

expected_entities.name: PostController.groovy
expected_entities.note: #6815: the #577 file carrier. PostController.groovy's three `import` declarations each anchor their IMPORTS edge on the path, so this is the entity that gives them a real FROM end. This fixture is a SINGLE file, so it can only grade the positive direction; the over-firing direction — no carrier for a file with no import — is graded in internal/extractors/groovy/file_carrier_6815_test.go and, at fixture level, by nim-objects-mini and erlang-otp-mini, which are multi-file.
